measure.measure_definition: Time to event: randomization to first documented disease progression or death from any cause, whichever occurs first; assessed by blinded independent review committee (IRC).; Participants; IRC assessment of radiological disease progression by computed tomography or magnetic resonance imaging at baseline, every 8 weeks for the first 6 cycles, every 12 weeks for cycles 7–24, and every 24 weeks thereafter until confirmed disease progression. IRC reviewers were unaware of treatment assignment.; PFS was defined as the time from randomization until disease progression or death, whichever occurred first. For patients alive without disease progression or lost to follow-up, data were censored at the date of last assessment. Response/progression assessment used iwCLL 2018 criteria for CLL and Cheson 2014 criteria for SLL; the primary PFS analysis was by IRC.

Categorical status: confirmed overall response (ORR) assessed by IRC.; Participants; IRC assessment of tumor response by computed tomography or magnetic resonance imaging at baseline and scheduled intervals; response assessed per iwCLL 2018 criteria for CLL or Cheson 2014 criteria for SLL. PR with lymphocytosis (PR-L) was also evaluated for patients receiving orelabrutinib and categorized as ORR as prespecified.; ORR was defined as the proportion of patients achieving complete response (CR), CR with incomplete count recovery (CRi), nodular partial response (nPR), or partial response (PR), assessed by IRC. For orelabrutinib, PR-L was also categorized as ORR as prespecified. Confirmed responses were used; 95% CIs were calculated with the Clopper–Pearson method.

Time to event: first documented response to disease progression or death from any cause, whichever occurs first; assessed by IRC.; Participants; IRC-assessed tumor response and subsequent radiological assessments; DoR measured from the first documented response until disease progression or death. IRC reviewers were unaware of treatment assignment.; DoR was defined as the time from the first documented response until disease progression or death. The analysis was restricted to IRC-assessed responders. Data were censored at the last assessment for patients alive without disease progression or lost to follow-up.

population.intervention_regimen: Orelabrutinib 150 mg once daily; chlorambucil 0.5 mg/kg on days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle; rituximab 375 mg/m² on day 1 of cycle 1 and 500 mg/m² on day 1 of cycles 2–6.; Orelabrutinib orally once daily continuously until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or consent withdrawal; chlorambucil plus rituximab for up to six 28-day cycles, or until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or consent withdrawal.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment allocation (orelabrutinib vs chlorambucil plus rituximab); all randomized patients.; Treatment-naïve chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (CLL/SLL) requiring therapy per iwCLL 2018 criteria; aged ≥65 years, or aged 18–65 years with coexisting comorbidities (creatinine clearance 30–69 mL/min by Cockcroft–Gault equation or Cumulative Illness Rating Scale for Geriatrics score >6); ECOG performance status ≤2; measurable disease; life expectancy >6 months; adequate hematologic, hepatic and renal function; no chromosome 17p13 deletion or TP53 mutation, central nervous system involvement, Richter transformation, or clinically significant cardiovascular disease; randomized 1:1. All randomized patients were included in the ITT population.
population.population_time_frame: Enrolment from February 20, 2021 to July 8, 2024; interim analysis data cutoff May 17, 2024. Median follow-up 21.4 months (range 0.03–40.3) for all patients.

population.intervention_regimen: 150 mg.; 150 mg orally once daily continuously until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or consent withdrawal.

population.population_definition: IRC-assessed response status (responders) within the orelabrutinib ITT group.; Treatment-naïve CLL/SLL; randomized to orelabrutinib; confirmed IRC-assessed overall response contributing to the IRC duration-of-response analysis; number at risk at 0 months in the IRC DoR Kaplan–Meier analysis was 82. Participants without an IRC-assessed response are excluded from this responder population. IRC response set includes CR, PR and PR-L: 82/91 (90.1%). Table 2 reports 74 alongside 90.1%, whereas the response definition including PR-L and the IRC DoR risk set support 82 responders. The reason for the discrepant count is not explicitly reported.

population.population_definition: Randomized participants from either treatment arm with a confirmed IRC-assessed overall response contributing to the interim duration-of-response analysis. For CLL, the SAP response categories include CR, CRi, PR, PR-L and nPR, with PR-L evaluated in the orelabrutinib arm. For SLL, response includes CR or PR. Figure 3a identifies 82 and 80 at risk at time zero for the two arms, respectively.
population.population_time_frame: Interim analysis data cutoff May 17, 2024. Duration of response starts at first qualifying response.
